t: What he said the day they kept him from the prayer
a: اللَّهُمَّ امْلأْ قُبُورَهُمْ وَبُيُوتَهُمْ نَارًا كَمَا شَغَلُونَا عَنْ صَلاَةِ الْوُسْطَى حَتَّى غَابَتِ الشَّمْسُ
p: Allāhumma-mlaʾ qubūrahum wa buyūtahum nāran kamā shaghalūnā ʿan ṣalāti-l-wusṭā ḥattā ghābati-sh-shams
m: O Allah, fill their graves and their houses with fire, as they kept us from the middle prayer until the sun went down.
